text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text:
*cough*... *cough*...
My deepest apologies, my lord.
It appears as though I have been afflicted by the monster's poison.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ケホ……ケホ……
主さま、
申し訳ございません。
わたくし、
魔物の毒をもらってしまったようです……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
That's what you get for calling it \"cute\" and letting your guard down...
Let me see.
text_block_list.orig_text:
カワイイとか言って油断してるからそういう目にあうのよ……
ちょっと見せてみなさい。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Well, it doesn't look like you've breathed too much of it in. The insides 
of your mouth are a little swollen, so that must be where you absorbed 
most of it. Chew on these medicinal herbs for a while.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まぁ、
深くは吸い込んでない様ね。
口の中がちょっと腫れちゃってるから、
沁みるかもしれないけど
この薬草をしばらく噛んでおくといいわ。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text:
*munch, munch* Thank you very much.
It appears as though I will come out of this mostly unscathed... *munch* Thanks to your assistance.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もぐもぐ……
ありがとうございます。
おかげさまで……
もぐ……
大事なく済みそうです。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text:
Oh please, stop being so dramatic.
A certain \"lord\" would be pretty lonely without you, right?
Anyway, that's a job complete!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なによ、
おおげさね。
あんたがいないと、
あ・る・じ・さ・まが寂しがるでしょ？
とにかくこれで、
依頼達成ね～☆
